notes: Prompts must not reuse drafts from references/examples.md, so the evals measure generalization rather than copying. For Portuguese drafts, the header labels (Intenção/Tom/Canal) and tone names (Direto/Colaborativo/CNV completa) must be in Portuguese.

evals.prompt: comenta no PR: pq tu usou useEffect aqui? isso vai rodar toda hora, coloca no useMemo
evals.expected_output: Header in Portuguese: Intenção/Tom: Direto/Canal: PR. One comment with 'suggestion:' (or 'question:'), 1-3 sentences, no 'você/tu', a genuine (non-rhetorical) question about why it's an effect, proposing useMemo. No invented claims about dependencies. Humanizer skipped (short), no Note about it.

evals.prompt: comenta no PR: falta teste pra esse caso de erro e o nome handleStuff é horrível
evals.expected_output: Header labels in Portuguese. Two separate PR comments, each with its own header: one 'todo:' or 'issue:' about the missing error-path test, one 'nitpick (non-blocking):' about the name, without 'horrível'. Suggested name as [placeholder], not invented. Note flags whether the missing test should block the merge.

evals.prompt: manda no canal: pessoal a api de vagas ta lenta desde o deploy de hoje cedo, p95 foi pra 3s, alguem do time de backend pode olhar
evals.expected_output: Header in Portuguese, Tom: Direto, Canal: Slack canal. BLUF: slowness and p95 3s in the first sentence, ask to backend. Keeps only facts from the draft (deploy this morning, p95 3s); dashboard/link as [placeholder]. No added emoji, max ~4 lines.

evals.prompt: time de infra, a gente precisa daquele bucket s3 liberado faz 2 semanas e ninguém responde o ticket, assim não dá
evals.expected_output: Header in Portuguese, Tom: Colaborativo, Canal: Slack (Infra channel). Removes 'assim não dá'. States the ticket has been open 2 weeks without reply, with [link]/[bucket] placeholders and what it blocks as [placeholder], and asks for an ETA or an owner. No invented deadline or impact.

evals.prompt: preciso falar com meu gestor que não vai dar pra entregar a feature de filtros na sprint, o escopo cresceu demais e o design mudou 3 vezes
evals.expected_output: Header in Portuguese, Tom: Colaborativo, Canal: Slack DM. Opens with the clear 'won't make it this sprint', gives the two reasons from the draft (scope grew, design changed 3 times), and leaves the proposal/next step as a [placeholder] instead of inventing options. Up to ~6 lines.

evals.prompt: DM pro beltrano: ele aprovou meu pr sem ler, de novo, e depois veio reclamar na daily que eu subi bug, isso é ridículo
evals.expected_output: Header in Portuguese, Tom: CNV completa, Canal: Slack DM. 'sem ler' replaced by an observable fact as [placeholder] (e.g. approved without comments). Contains observation, a feeling owned by the sender, a need and a concrete negotiable request. No 'ridículo', no 'de novo'. 4+ sentences, so the humanizer path is applied if installed. Note may suggest retro/lead if it keeps happening.

evals.prompt: Make this a PR comment: this will crash if the user has no company, user.company.id is undefined and the whole page dies
evals.expected_output: Output and header in English. Tone: Direct, Channel: PR. Comment starts with 'issue (blocking):', explains the crash when company is missing and that it takes down the page, and asks for the case to be handled before merge. 1-3 sentences.

evals.prompt: can u merge my PR pls, it's been sitting there for days and it's blocking release
evals.expected_output: Output and header in English. Tone: Collaborative (deadline follow-up) or Direct. Asks for review/merge with [PR link], mentions it is open for days and blocking the release, and leaves any deadline as a [placeholder]. No invented number of days or date.
No message is produced. The skill asks one question in Portuguese about what the message needs to say. It does not invent content.
